hero.lead: A friendly, active clan where every attack counts and every member gets noticed. Come build with us.

why.title: A clan that actually plays.
why.subtitle: Four things you can expect from us.

perks.title: Active wars
perks.text: Back-to-back wars with clear plans, so your stars always matter.

perks.title: Fair donations
perks.text: Donate, receive, repeat. Nobody gets left on an empty castle.

perks.title: Capital & Games
perks.text: We push Clan Games and Capital raids together, all the way to max rewards.

perks.title: Good vibes
perks.text: New to the game or maxed out, you'll find people who help you improve.

champions.title: Meet our top trophy pushers.
champions.subtitle: Tap a champion to see their full base stats.

join.title: Join in three taps.
join.subtitle: No forms. No waiting lists. Just a request and a warm welcome.

steps.title: Open the game
steps.text: Launch Clash of Clans, or tap the join button on your phone.

steps.title: Find us
steps.text: Search our clan tag in the clan search.

steps.title: Send a request
steps.text: Hit Join or Request. We'll accept you fast.

requirements: Be active at least once a day
join.finalSubtitle: Bring your best army. We'll bring the rest.
